translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Uwosi bititalagila biyomitali matausina topupagatu
Guyau iluki Mosese sola Eroni
karaiwaga makwaisina paila kasi karaiwaga mina Isireli. Ka, kidamwa avai tau biyosi pokesa, e pokesa makwaina kwepupagatu,
kaina bibubusi kaina bikabodi.
Avai moi matauna bisikaila kaina bikanakaila makwaina kwepupagatu.
Kidamwa availa bikabikoni la moi
kaina bisimapu kabala, ibodi matauna biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, e bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
E kidamwa availa bikabikoni matauna isim kala pokesa, matauna ibodi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
Kidamwa matauna isim kala pokesa bigiu availa tobwaila matauna ibodi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
Kidamwa tau matauna isim kala pokesa bisikaila avai kebila wala, kabosisu makwaina bogwa eipupagatu.

Kidamwa availa bikabikoni avai vavagi wala matauna isim kala pokesa eisikaila, matauna bogwa eiyogwali titoulela, e bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki. E kidamwa availa bikau avai vavagi wala matauna isim kala pokesa eisikaila, matauna ibodi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
Kidamwa matauna isim kala pokesa gala biwini yamala e bikabikoni taitala tomanabwaita, e tau matauna ibodi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
E kidamwa matauna isim kala pokesa bikabikoni kwelatala kulimoya, makwelana ibodi bikatumkumkwaisi, deli kidamwa bikabikoni kaitala kaboma, makaina ibodi biwinaisi.
Avai tuta tau matauna isim kala pokesa bogwa bibwaina, ibodi bisisu kwailima kwaiyu yam, oluvi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya sopi utuwotu, e matauna bogwa bimigileu mokwita.
E yam kwailima kwaitolula bibudoki, matauna bikau nayu bubuna kaina buneroro bilau omatala Guyau la Buliyoyova e bisaiki minasina baisa tolula.
E tolula bigabu natana paila mitugaga lulela, deli nayuwela paila lula kwegubugabu, baisa makawala matauna bivagi avaka kasi gulogula paila tau matauna kala katumigileu.
Kidamwa taitala la sopi bibusimakava wala, matauna ibodi bikakaya tomwaidona, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
E avai vavagi eiyoudulokaisi metoya karekwa kaina mauna kanuvinesi bikogiaki tau matauna la sopi, ibodi biwinaisi makwaina, mitaga bisisu wala kwepupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
Kidamwa taitala tau sola natana vivila bivenokusi kanavai, kasitaiyu wala bikakayasi, mitaga bisisuaisi wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.

Kidamwa natana vivila kala tubukona buyavila bititalagila, minana napupagatu, e bisisu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam. E kidamwa availa bikabikoni minana bogwa eiyogwali titoulela e bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
Avai vavagi minana bisikaila kaina bikanakaila tutala buyavila eititalagila, vavagi makwaina kwepupagatu wala.
E kidamwa availa bikabikoni la moi kaina avai vavagi wala minana leisikaila, ibodi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.

E kidamwa minana igau wala buyavila eititalagila, e taitalaga bimokaia minana, matauna bogwa eiyogwali titoulela metoya minana pupagatula wowola, e matauna bisisu wala topupagatu biboda kwailima kwaiyu yam, e kidamwa avai moi bikanakaila, moi makwaina kwepupagatu wala.

Kidamwa natana vivila bikabuyaimakava wala kwaivila yam gala kala tubukona, kaina bogwa eibudoki kala tubukona mitaga bisetuwoli wala bititalagila lopola, e makawala kala kaduwonaku bititalagila lopola e minana bisisu wala napupagatu.
Avai moi minana bikanakaila kaina avai vavagi bisikaila otutala eikikabuyavi makwaina kwepupagatu.
Kidamwa availa bikabikoni vavagi makwaisina matauna bogwa eiyogwali titoulela mapaila matauna ibodi biwini kala karekwa deli bikakaya, mitaga bisisu wala topupagatu kaukwau bila ibugiki.
Avai tuta vivila minana bitaboda buyavila, minana ibodi bisisu kwailima kwaiyu yam, e minana bogwa bimigileu.
E yam kwailima kwaitolula bibudoki, minana ibodi bikau nayu bubuna kaina nayu buneroro e bilau Guyau ola Buliyoyova wa lulu, e bisaiki minasina tolula.
E tolula bigabu natana paila mitugaga lulela e nayuwela paila lula kwegubugabu, baisa makawala matauna bivagi avaka kasi gulogula paila tau matauna kala katumigileu.
Guyau iluki Mosese bikatululuti mina Isireli paila kasi pupagatu, taga biyogwalaisi Guyau la Buliyoyova, makwaina eitotu oluwalela kabosikaiwa. Kidamwa bivagaisi makawala, bikaligasi.
Karaiwaga makwaisina paila karaiwogala avai tau bikapokesa kaina bibusimakava la sopi,
kaina avai vila kala tubukona buyavila bititalagila, kaina taitala tau bimokaia natana vivila minana napupagatu deli buyavila eititalagila.
